Skill Families: 枚举输入来源(command line/env/default/config) → 找统一取值入口 → 核对 precedence/tie-break → 再做类型转换 → 用来源组合矩阵验证。
同一参数可从多个来源获得，显式值被默认值/环境变量覆盖，或行为随来源变化。
单一来源的普通 parser bug；与来源优先级无关的纯类型转换。
没有 Skill 时 Agent 容易直接修 parser/默认值，忽略真正的 source-selection 顺序和组合回归。
先保留 raw multiplicity/structure → 找 flatten/split 边界 → 仅在类型层转换 → 覆盖单值/多值/空值/重复 key 顺序。
list/tuple/repeated query key/envvar sequence/multipart 等结构化输入被压平、拼错或只保留一个值。
只是来源 precedence；纯字符串编码问题。
常见错误是就地 special-case 一个输入，而 Skill 会强制沿 raw→collection→typed 的完整边界检查。
画出 acquire→use→release → 找所有 early-exit/exception/cancel/abandon 路径 → 用 finally/context-manager/ExitStack 保证释放 → 显式验证 close/teardown。
stream/context/client/callback/lifespan 在异常、跳转、提前退出时未关闭或 teardown 不执行。
只是 stale state，没有需要释放的资源；纯 handler 语义。
正常路径测试会掩盖问题；Skill 强制枚举异常/提前退出路径和可观测的 close 证据。
确认对象已注册 → 追踪 registry/build/lookup 三阶段 → 核对 name/prefix/namespace → 同时验证枚举(help/reverse)与真实 dispatch/invoke。
route/command/sub-app 已声明但 help、reverse lookup 或请求/调用找不到，或 nested prefix/namespace 异常。
对象能正确找到但内部执行逻辑错；URL 字符串只存在编码/斜杠规范化问题。
Agent 常直接在 endpoint/command 内改逻辑，但真正根因通常发生在注册构建或 lookup 阶段。
Tasks: When FOO is set in the environment, explicitly provided command-line values for a variadic argument are ignored. Explicit CLI input should win over the environment, while env/default behavior must still work when CLI input is absent. Please locate and fix the regression.
Move or bias envvar resolution ahead of explicit command-line values for variadic inputs.
With FOO set, `cmd a b` returns env/default/empty instead of ('a','b'); env-only still appears correct.
Enumerate command line/env/default sources → inspect central consume path → restore precedence → verify source matrix.
The defect is in source selection order, not tuple parsing itself.
CLI-only uses CLI; env-only uses env; both uses CLI; default only uses default; parameter source is correct.
Without the Skill the symptom looks like parser corruption; the useful shortcut is to inspect source precedence first.

A paired `--with-x/--without-x` option ignores an explicitly supplied disabling flag in some default configurations. The explicit flag must always beat the configured default. Fix it without changing the no-argument behavior.
Break the tie-break between an explicitly selected flag value and an explicit default so default can overwrite user input.
`--without-x` yields the default enabled value; no-argument and `--with-x` may still pass.
List possible sources including explicit-default metadata → check tie-break after parsing → test all flag combinations.
A default can itself carry provenance; precedence must be decided after tracking source, not by comparing values.
No flag keeps default; each explicit flag wins; paired flags remain deterministic.
This is intentionally a near-neighbor of T01 but at a different tie-break stage, testing whether the Skill generalizes beyond envvars.

A `multiple=True` or multi-arity option loaded from an environment variable is treated as one raw string instead of multiple values. Restore the intended multi-value behavior while preserving scalar options.
Bypass type-level environment splitting for multiple/nargs values and return the raw string.
Env-only multi-value option becomes one item; scalar envvar still passes.
Preserve raw multiplicity → identify collection-depth/type split boundary → split once → validate scalar/multiple/nargs cases.
Splitting belongs at the collection/type boundary, not generic string processing.
Scalar unchanged; multiple and nargs values preserve count/order; empty envvar behavior remains correct.
The Skill prevents an ad-hoc whitespace split that would break composite types or double-split later.

Resources registered with `Context.call_on_close()` / `Context.with_resource()` are not released when a command exits through an early-exit/error path, even though normal completion cleans them up. Make cleanup reliable for every exit path.
Skip or detach ExitStack close callbacks on one early-exit / Click exception path.
Normal command closes resource; error/early exit leaves close callback uncalled.
Trace acquire→invoke→all exit paths → ensure Context.close/ExitStack unwinds in finally semantics → verify observable close exactly once.
The core issue is lifecycle coverage across non-local exits, not the resource implementation.
Close callback runs exactly once on success, ClickException, Abort/Exit; original exit code remains intact.
Without the Skill it is easy to patch the specific error branch; the reusable method is to audit the full exit graph.
A command added to a Group is present internally but is missing from help or cannot be invoked through the same name. Restore consistency between registration, listing, lookup, and invocation.
Introduce inconsistent normalization/filtering between list_commands and get_command so one registered command is hidden or unresolvable.
Command object exists; help listing and invocation disagree.
Verify registration → compare registry/list/get/resolve stages → normalize name once → test help and dispatch.
A registry can be correct while discovery/lookup is inconsistent; endpoint code is not the root cause.
Registered command appears in help, get_command resolves it, and invocation reaches its callback; unknown command still fails.
The Skill directs the agent away from editing the command body and toward registry/build/lookup consistency.

Change one replacement name in the warning string to an incorrect sibling attribute.
Only one warning message is wrong; behavior and APIs are otherwise correct.
Find the exact warning site and align it with the documented replacement.
Exact warning text and category/stacklevel; unrelated Context behavior unchanged.
